definition: In linear algebra, the trace of a square matrix is the sum of its main diagonal entries.
entry_text: In linear algebra, the trace of a square matrix is the sum of its main diagonal entries.
example: The trace of a diagonal matrix with entries two and five is seven.
label: Trace (linear algebra)

sources.note: MIT course notes equations 2.33 and 2.47 explicitly sum the diagonal of a square operator matrix.
